import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);

        String theDNA = sc.next();
        int wholeCounter = 0, tempCounter = 1;
        char previousCharacter = theDNA.charAt(0);
        for (int i = 1; i < theDNA.length(); i++) {
            if (previousCharacter == theDNA.charAt(i)) {
                tempCounter++;
                previousCharacter = theDNA.charAt(i);
                if (i != theDNA.length() - 1 && theDNA.charAt(i + 1) != previousCharacter) {
                    if (tempCounter % 2 == 0) {
                        wholeCounter++;
                        tempCounter = 1;
                    }
                } else if (tempCounter % 2 == 0) {
                    wholeCounter++;
                    tempCounter = 1;
                }
            } else {
                previousCharacter = theDNA.charAt(i);
                tempCounter = 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(wholeCounter);
    }
}
